name: Halfling
description: The comforts of home are the goals of most halflings' lives: a place to settle in peace and quiet, far from marauding monsters and clashing armies. Yet halfling adventurers are surprisingly common among their kind, off seeking adventure and fortune far from home.

grants.name: Lucky
grants.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

grants.name: Brave
grants.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

grants.name: Halfling Nimbleness
grants.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you.

grants.name: Naturally Stealthy
grants.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

grants.name: Stout Resilience
grants.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance to poison damage.
